name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of forts and palaces
summary: See Amber Fort first thing, then the palaces and bazaars of the walled Pink City. Two full days is enough, with sunset from Nahargarh Fort.
seasonNote: April to June is very hot; the monsoon runs July to September.
arrival: The airport is 30 minutes from the centre; trains from Delhi take 4 to 5 hours.
gettingAround: Use ride-hailing apps or hire a car and driver for the day; agree auto-rickshaw fares first.
cashTip: Carry small notes for rickshaws and bazaars; fort tickets can be paid by card.
foodTip: Try dal baati churma, pyaaz kachori, laal maas (spicy mutton) and a lassi in a clay cup.
buyTip: Block-printed textiles, blue pottery and gemstones only from reputable shops; ignore commission touts.

connections.note: About 4 hours by train or road.

items.name: Amber Fort
items.summary: A hilltop fort-palace of courtyards, mirrored halls and ramparts above a lake.
items.expect: Hot, with many steps; elephant rides are offered but discouraged on welfare grounds.
items.tip: Walk or take a jeep up at 8 am.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult in local currency, not a live ticket quote; check current prices and what is included.
items.sourceNote: Editorial selection. Durations, spending allowances and itinerary advice are planning estimates; check opening days and prices with the venue before you go.
whyVisit: A hilltop fort-palace of courtyards, mirrored halls and ramparts above a lake.
It is Rajasthan's most impressive fort.
visitFlow: See the Sheesh Mahal mirror hall and upper palace.
items.bestFor: Visitors interested in history and context and architecture and design
tradeoffs: Hot, with many steps; elephant rides are offered but discouraged on welfare grounds.
Walk or take a jeep up at 8 am.

items.tip: Don't miss the four painted season gates in the inner courtyard.

items.name: Jantar Mantar
items.summary: An 18th-century observatory of giant stone instruments, including the world's largest sundial.
items.expect: Little shade, and hard to follow without explanation.
items.tip: Hire a guide or audio guide at the gate.
